## Why

I7's rights packets recorded seven registry/tenant corrections the
operator approved under X4. Six wrong `jurisdiction` labels would have
the agenda layer mint candidate identifiers (SIG-INGEST-034) naming the
wrong city/county/state once the P35.8 keyword-filtered matter pass and
the Wave-A widening run over these tenants — so claims land with false
jurisdiction values that the append-only spine can only correct forward.
The mirror row's "non-state runneals account" classification was a
live-read-refuted misattribution (I5 NEW-5), and the FAA homepage pointed
at a generic landing page rather than the waiver tables the row
describes (I4 NEW-7).

## What ships

- **M1–M5 label fixes** —
  `connectors/src/connectors/data/agenda_tenants.toml`, six
  `jurisdiction` corrections verbatim per I8 §4.1: `charlotte_ia` →
  "Charlotte, NC" · `concord_ca` → "Concord, NH" · `san_bernardino_ca` →
  "San Bernardino County, CA" · `newark` → "Newark, NJ" · `clark` →
  "Clark County, NV" · `carrollton_ga` → "Carrollton, TX".
- **Key-stability check** — recorded, with a test pin: agenda subjects
  are minted `agenda_item:<src>:<tenant_id>:<external_id>` and
  `tenant_id` is the TOML **row key** (not the platform `tenant` slug —
  `procurement.py` `tenant_targets` + `_normalize_agenda_item`). The key
  enters the claim identity, so keys stay unchanged; only labels were
  corrected.
- **M6** — `data/dot_511_targets.toml`
  `[[enumerated]] ncdot_runneals_mirror` now declares its lineage in
  registry fields (SIG-CONF-014 shape): `mirror_of`/`derived_from` =
  `dot_511_nc` plus `lineage_evidence` citing the I5 NEW-5 live-read
  (ArcGIS org `NuWFvHYDMVmmxMeM` hosts NCDOT-owned services; the live
  `NCDOT_Cameras` layer answers 1,157 cameras — the "runneals" item
  registrant is not the hosting authority). The row's stale
  "non-state runneals account" note is corrected, as is the same
  misclassification in the `drivenc` probe note; nothing deleted —
  mirror retirement is the Wave-C OSM/dot_511 work (P37.2 / ACQ-18, R5),
  and the PA/NJ "runneals" rows are untouched (I5 NEW-5: possibly
  similar, *unverified*).
- **M7** — `sources.toml [sources.faa_drone_waivers].homepage_url` now
  points at the FAA **Part 91.113 "Waivers Issued"** table (DFR
  authorizations — the channel the row's `authorization_state` notes
  describe); the companion **Part 107** table (unexpired waivers only)
  is recorded verbatim in `notes` (I4 NEW-7).
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_agenda_tenant_labels.py`: the six
  rows resolve to the corrected jurisdictions via `agenda_tenants()` and
  via the connector's `tenant_targets("legistar")` resolution; the
  key-is-identity pin; the M6 lineage marking; the M7 homepage/notes.

No production mutation, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no
HG-03 answer, no scheduler enablement, no claim-spine write. The Legistar

activation is P35.11; the OUSD/Washoe tenant disposition is P35.8;

stand — corrections are new claims on the next run.
